statements.text:
Proud to announce Haashini Balasubramanian of @CoxMillHS as the NC-06 Congressional App Challenge winner!

Her app, Nestling, uses AI to help NICU families transition home with confidence, compassion, and clarity. https://t.co/YTyYi39eSP

Communist China should have ZERO influence over U.S. AI policy.

The AI race and America's approach to AI will help shape the world for generations to come.

The future of AI belongs in American hands and cannot be dictated by Beijing.

https://t.co/8RnFZ23I7N

Today I led a bipartisan bill with @Rep_Walkinshaw to increase oversight of AI use under FISA.

AI is changing how information is collected, and Congress must ensure these tools strengthen national security while protecting the constitutional rights that define our country.
https://t.co/lMjMPG3HTg

Artificial intelligence is changing the way industries across our country are collecting and analyzing information. [...] Congress has a responsibility to ensure these tools strengthen our national security while protecting the constitutional rights and freedoms that define our Nation.
statements.venue: Press release introducing the FISA AI Reporting Act (mcdowell.house.gov)
